meals.name: The OG Girl Dinner
meals.description: Bread, butter, sharp cheese, grapes, and pickles. The medieval peasant plate that started it all.

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar or aged gouda, sliced

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay the 2 slices of sourdough on a wooden board. Slather them thickly with the 2 tablespoons of room temperature butter so it melts into the bread. Slice the 60g of sharp cheddar or aged gouda and lay it alongside the bread. Add a small bunch of red grapes and a few cornichons or dill pickles to fill the gaps. There are no rules here, just arrange by color and texture and enjoy the contrast of creamy butter, sharp cheese, and briny pickles.

meals.notes: The original Olivia Maher TikTok that started the whole trend. Use the best butter you can find because it matters here.

meals.headnote: This plate is built around contrast: creamy, crisp, salty, and fresh in every few bites. Give each ingredient its own space and assemble combinations as you eat.

meals.name: Whipped Feta with Hot Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: Creamy, salty, sweet, and crunchy. Four textures in one bowl with zero cooking required.

steps.name: Whip
steps.text: Add the 150g of crumbled feta and 2 tablespoons of cream cheese to a food processor. Blend for a full 2 minutes, scraping down the sides halfway, until the mixture is completely smooth and fluffy. If it feels too stiff, add a tiny splash of water to loosen it.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spoon the whipped feta into a shallow bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of hot honey directly into the swirl. Scatter a handful of roughly chopped toasted walnuts over the top so they fall into the crevices. Serve immediately with crackers or crusty bread.

meals.notes: No food processor? Mash with a fork and beat vigorously. Less smooth but still excellent.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of ceramic bowl of whipped feta drizzled with hot honey and scattered with toasted walnuts, served with crackers
meals.headnote: The texture should be soft enough to scoop but sturdy enough to hold a swirl. Taste before garnishing because cheese, canned ingredients, and crackers can bring plenty of salt.

meals.substitutions: No feta cheese? White beans, roasted eggplant, or extra yogurt blend into an equally dippable base. Taste and re-salt after blending.
meals.storage: Refrigerate up to four days in a sealed container. Flavor often improves overnight; stir before serving and refresh with olive oil or lemon.

meals.name: Chilli Crisp Noodles with Soft-Boiled Egg
meals.description: Six minute noodles that taste like you ordered them from a really good spot.

ingredients.name: dried noodles (ramen, soba, or rice noodles)

steps.name: Soft boil egg
steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to a rolling boil. Gently lower the 1 large egg into the water and set a timer for exactly 6.5 minutes for a perfectly jammy yolk. Transfer the egg immediately to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process, then peel it under cold running water.

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Boil the 1 portion of dried noodles in the same pot according to the package until chewy. While they cook, whisk the 1.5 tbsp chilli crisp, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, and 1 tsp rice vinegar together in the bottom of your serving bowl.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Drain the noodles and add them directly to the sauce bowl. Toss vigorously with tongs until every strand is coated in the spicy oil. Halve the soft boiled egg and place it on top of the noodles, letting the yolk run slightly. Scatter the 2 thinly sliced spring onions over the top and eat right away while piping hot.

meals.notes: Fly By Jing chilli crisp is worth the upgrade over Lao Gan Ma. Add peanut butter for a satay vibe.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of noodles in red chilli crisp oil topped with a halved soft boiled egg and spring onions
meals.headnote: This is a fast bowl with enough salt, heat, and richness to taste considered. The key is coating every strand rather than leaving the sauce pooled underneath.
meals.seoTitle: Chilli Crisp Noodles with Soft-Boiled Egg | foidslop

meals.substitutions: Instant ramen, soba, rice noodles, or wheat noodles all work interchangeably. No egg? Chilli oil alone with scallions still makes the bowl interesting.
meals.storage: Keeps one day refrigerated, sauce separate if possible. Cold noodles are legitimate here; loosen with hot water or serve straight from the fridge.

meals.name: Baked Feta Pasta
meals.description: The TikTok pasta that broke the internet. Roasted tomatoes, melted feta, done.

steps.name: Roast
steps.text: Preheat your oven to 400F/200C. Place the 200g of cherry tomatoes and 3 cloves of smashed, unpeeled garlic in the center of a baking dish. Nestle the 100g block of feta right in the middle. Pour 3 tablespoons of olive oil over the tomatoes and feta, and sprinkle with chilli flakes. Roast for 35 minutes until the tomatoes burst and release their juices, and the feta turns golden on top.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: While the feta roasts, boil the 100g of pasta in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a full cup of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Remove the baking dish from the oven. Squeeze the soft roasted garlic out of its skins and mash it into the melted feta with a fork. Add the drained pasta and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir everything together vigorously until the cheese and tomato juices emulsify into a glossy, silky sauce. Top with a handful of torn fresh basil.

meals.notes: Use the best quality block feta you can find. Pre crumbled will not melt the same way.
meals.photo_search: baked pasta with melted feta and burst cherry tomatoes in a ceramic casserole dish
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of baked pasta with melted feta and burst cherry tomatoes in a ceramic casserole dish
meals.headnote: Small-batch pasta rewards the same care as a larger pot. Salt the water, finish the noodles with the sauce, and serve as soon as the texture is right.
meals.seoTitle: Baked Feta Pasta Recipe for One | foidslop

meals.substitutions: Different short pasta shapes swap freely here. No cherry tomatoes? Pecorino, asiago, or extra-black-pepper parmesan covers the same role in the sauce.
meals.storage: Refrigerate up to two days. Reheat gently in a covered pan with a splash of water to bring the sauce back to glossy; microwaving works at half power.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Everything Bagel Plate
meals.description: Creamy cottage cheese, juicy tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning make a savory plate with plenty of crunch.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Scoop the 1 cup of full fat cottage cheese into a wide, shallow bowl. Use the back of a spoon to create a deep divot in the center of the cheese. Pour a generous drizzle of good olive oil directly into the divot. Shower the top with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning so the seeds fall into the oil and cheese. Arrange a handful of halved cherry tomatoes around the edges and serve with crackers or cucumber slices for scooping.

meals.notes: Add chilli crisp instead of olive oil for a spicy upgrade. Trader Joe's Everything But The Bagel seasoning is the move.

meals.name: Tinned Sardines on Buttered Toast
meals.description: Briny, rich, and done in two minutes. The girl dinner for people with great taste.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt, black pepper, hot sauce

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of sourdough until they are deeply golden and crisp. While the bread is still piping hot, spread 1 tablespoon of salted butter generously over the surface so it melts deep into the crumbs.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Open the tin of sardines and lay them in a single layer over the buttered toast. Squeeze the juice of half a lemon directly over the fish. Add flaky sea salt, black pepper, and your favorite hot sauce. If you are using dijon mustard and sliced cornichons, smear the mustard on the bread before adding the sardines, and place the cornichons on top for a briny crunch.

meals.notes: Brand matters enormously. A good tin of sardines in olive oil is a completely different thing from the cheap supermarket version.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast heavily buttered and topped with sardines, lemon wedges, and black pepper
meals.headnote: This is quick, but it still benefits from attention at the edges. Toast the bread until properly golden, season the topping, and assemble only when you are ready to eat.

meals.storage: Toast cannot be stored assembled. Keep toppings in one container and bread separately; rebuild under the broiler for a few minutes when round two calls.

meals.name: Burrata with Peach and Prosciutto
meals.description: Sweet peach, salty prosciutto, creamy burrata. Summer on a plate with no cooking required.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Place the 1 ball of fresh burrata in the center of a beautiful plate. Slice the 1 ripe peach and arrange the slices around the burrata. Drape the 3 slices of prosciutto di Parma over the peaches. Tuck a handful of fresh basil leaves into the gaps. Just before eating, tear the burrata open so the creamy center spills out. Finish with a drizzle of good olive oil, a swirl of balsamic glaze, and a pinch of flaky salt.

meals.notes: Tear the burrata open at the table so the cream spills out. Only works with ripe, in season peaches.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon Plate with Cream Cheese and Capers
meals.description: Deli style but make it dinner. Everything a bagel would be without the bagel.

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay the 80g of smoked salmon slices on one side of a plate. Put the 3 tablespoons of cream cheese in a small bowl on the opposite side. Scatter 1 tablespoon of capers and the very thinly sliced red onion over the salmon. Add a handful of rye crackers, a few sprigs of fresh dill, and a lemon wedge for squeezing. Build little cracker sandwiches as you eat.

meals.notes: Let red onion soak in a splash of lemon juice for 10 minutes to mellow the bite.

meals.name: Avocado Toast with Everything Bagel and Chilli Flakes
meals.description: Yes it is basic. Yes it is still perfect. The seasoning and chilli flakes make it.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of thick sourdough until deeply golden and crisp.

steps.name: Mash and top
steps.text: Halve the 1 large ripe avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh directly onto the hot toast. Use a fork to mash it roughly right on the bread. Immediately squeeze fresh lemon or lime juice over the avocado to prevent browning. Shower with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning, a pinch of chilli flakes, and a sprinkle of flaky salt.

meals.notes: A fried or poached egg makes the toast more substantial. Pomegranate seeds add a tart pop and extra crunch.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast topped with mashed avocado, everything bagel seasoning, and chilli flakes
meals.headnote: The bread needs to be deeply crisp before the topping goes on. That sturdy base keeps the last bite as good as the first and gives the softer ingredients some contrast.

meals.name: Hummus Plate with Warm Pita and Toppings
meals.description: A good hummus plate hits different when the pita is warm and the toppings are thoughtful.

steps.name: Warm pita
steps.text: Place the 1 pita bread directly over a gas flame or in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side until it puffs up and gets charred in spots.

steps.name: Build the plate
steps.text: Spoon the 1/2 cup of hummus into a bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle generously with olive oil and dust with 1/4 teaspoon of smoked paprika. Arrange the halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and olives around the hummus. Tear the warm pita into wedges and serve alongside for dipping.

meals.notes: Sabra is fine but Ithaca or Oren's Hummus will genuinely change the dish.

meals.name: Lazy Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Kraft in a pot, made correctly. Extra butter, black pepper, and no apologies.

ingredients.name: Kraft mac and cheese or Annie's
salted butter (more than the box says)
hot sauce, extra shredded cheese, breadcrumbs

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Boil the pasta from the 1 box of mac and cheese according to the package instructions. Drain the pasta, but leave about a tablespoon of the starchy cooking water in the pot to help the sauce bind.

steps.name: Make it better
steps.text: Return the pot to very low heat. Add 2 tablespoons of salted butter (more than the box recommends), the cheese powder, and just a small splash of whole milk. Stir vigorously until the butter and powder melt into a glossy sauce that coats every noodle. Finish with a very generous grinding of black pepper to cut the richness.

meals.notes: The secret is extra butter and less milk than the box says. Top with butter toasted breadcrumbs if you want to feel fancy.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of creamy macaroni and cheese topped with freshly ground black pepper
meals.headnote: The sauce is simple enough to make while the water heats. Reserve a splash of starchy cooking water before draining because it is what helps the whole bowl come together.

meals.name: Grilled Cheese Dipped in Tomato Soup
meals.description: The ultimate comfort duo. Golden buttery bread, melted cheese, silky soup for dunking.

ingredients.name: American cheese or sharp cheddar, sliced
splash of cream stirred into soup

steps.name: Heat soup
steps.text: Pour the 1 can of tomato soup into a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in a splash of cream if you want it extra rich. Keep it warm while you make the sandwich.

steps.name: Grill the cheese
steps.text: Spread the 2 tablespoons of softened butter evenly on the outside of both slices of bread. Place the 60g of sliced cheese between the unbuttered sides. Heat a pan over medium low heat. Cook the sandwich for 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing down gently with a spatula, until both sides are deeply golden and the cheese is completely melted.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Cut the grilled cheese in half diagonally. Ladle the hot soup into a mug or bowl. Dunk the sandwich directly into the soup and eat immediately.

meals.notes: Medium low heat is the key to grilled cheese. Patience gives you an even golden crust without burnt bread.
meals.photo_search: grilled cheese sandwich cut in half, served with a bowl of tomato soup for dipping
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of grilled cheese sandwich cut in half, served with a bowl of tomato soup for dipping
meals.headnote: A modest amount of broth can still have plenty of character. Let the aromatics bloom, use a gentle simmer, and finish with something fresh or sharp.

meals.name: Charcuterie Snack Plate for One
meals.description: All the hits of a charcuterie board scaled down to a solo dinner plate.

ingredients.name: aged cheddar or manchego, sliced or cubed

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Fan the 30g of salami or prosciutto out on one side of a plate. Place the 30g of sliced or cubed aged cheddar on the opposite side. Fill the middle with a handful of crackers. Add a small bowl with 1 tablespoon of mustard, and scatter handfuls of grapes, olives, and cornichons in the gaps so everything is easy to reach. Leave some white space on the plate so it does not look crowded.

meals.notes: Odd numbers look better. Three types of element minimum. Do not crowd. Leave some white space on the plate.

meals.name: Butter Noodles with Parmesan and Black Pepper
meals.description: Cacio e pepe's lazy cousin. Butter, parmesan, pepper, done in 10 minutes.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of spaghetti in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a large mug of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Butter and toss
steps.text: Return the drained pasta to the pot off the heat. Add the 3 tablespoons of salted butter and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss vigorously with tongs until the butter emulsifies with the starch and coats every strand. Add the 40g of finely grated parmesan and more pasta water, tossing again until you have a silky sauce.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Finish with 1 teaspoon of coarsely ground black pepper and top with extra parmesan.

meals.notes: The pasta water is the secret. The starch helps the butter create a silky sauce that clings to the noodles.

meals.name: Scrambled Eggs with Cream Cheese and Chives
meals.description: Low and slow eggs with cream cheese folded in. The softest, richest scramble.

steps.name: Whisk
steps.text: Crack the 3 large eggs into a bowl and beat them thoroughly with a pinch of salt until completely uniform.

steps.name: Low and slow
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of salted butter in a small non stick pan over the absolute lowest heat. Pour in the eggs and stir constantly with a rubber spatula, scraping the bottom and sides to form soft curds. This should take 5 to 7 minutes. Do not rush it.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: When the eggs are just barely set and still look slightly wet, remove the pan from the heat. Fold in 1 tablespoon of cream cheese so it melts from the residual heat. Top with a small bunch of snipped fresh chives and black pepper.

meals.notes: Keep it low and slow and keep it moving. Taking it off the heat early is not optional.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of soft scrambled eggs with cream cheese and chives, served with toast
meals.headnote: The difference between tender eggs and dry ones is usually the final minute. Watch the texture rather than the clock and serve as soon as they are set.

meals.storage: Eggs are best straight from the pan. Leftovers keep one day covered and reheat softly in a buttered pan over low heat; avoid the microwave if texture matters.

meals.name: Brie with Jam and Apple on a Board
meals.description: Ripe brie, sharp jam, crisp apple slices. The girl dinner that feels like a French picnic.

ingredients.name: crisp apple (Granny Smith or Honeycrisp), thinly sliced

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Place the 1 wedge of ripe brie on a small board. Spoon 1 tablespoon of fig or raspberry jam right alongside it. Thinly slice half of a crisp apple and fan the slices out on the board. Add a handful of water biscuits. Drizzle honey over the brie and add walnuts if you want extra crunch.

meals.notes: Let the brie sit at room temperature for 30 minutes first. Cold brie is a tragedy.

meals.name: Greek Salad with Chickpeas
meals.description: The most refreshing no cook dinner. Salty, crunchy, and genuinely satisfying.

steps.name: Prepare
steps.text: Combine the half can of drained chickpeas, chunked cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion in a bowl.  Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 tablespoon of red wine vinegar, and half a teaspoon of dried oregano.

steps.name: Dress and finish
steps.text: Season with salt and pepper and let it sit for 10 minutes so the tomatoes release their juices.  Top with 50g of crumbled feta just before eating.

meals.notes: Let it sit for 10 minutes after dressing. The tomatoes release juice that becomes the best extra dressing.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of chunky cucumber, cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, olives, and crumbled feta

meals.substitutions: The base swaps freely: if magnesium powder is unavailable, any juice or syrup in the same flavor family keeps the balance. Build strong, pour over ice, adjust after one sip.
meals.storage: Build fresh. Juice bases keep about two days refrigerated but always add bubbles and ice at serving time.

meals.name: Cold Sesame Noodles
meals.description: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot.

ingredients.name: shredded cucumber, sesame seeds, spring onion, chilli oil

steps.name: Cook and cool
steps.text: Boil the 100g of noodles per package, then rinse under cold water until completely cool. Drain well.

steps.name: Sauce and toss
steps.text: Whisk the 2 tablespoons of tahini, 1 tablespoon of soy, 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil. Thin with water until silky. Toss the cold noodles with the sauce. Top with shredded cucumber, spring onions, sesame seeds, and a swirl of chilli oil.

meals.notes: Make extra sauce. It also works as a dressing for any vegetable.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of cold noodles in dark sesame sauce, topped with cucumber, spring onions, and chilli oil
meals.headnote: The sauce should be ready before the noodles are drained. That way they can go straight into the bowl or pan while hot, loose, and ready to take on flavor.
meals.seoTitle: Cold Sesame Noodles Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot. A clear single-serving recipe ready in 18 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Sauce bases swap freely if you are out of tahini or sesame paste: peanut butter thinned with hot water, tahini plus soy, or simply more chilli oil each carry a bowl.
meals.storage: Keeps one day refrigerated, sauce separate if possible. Cold noodles are legitimate here; loosen with hot water or serve straight from the fridge.

meals.name: Prosciutto and Melon
meals.description: The Italian classic that needs no recipe. Sweet cantaloupe and salty prosciutto.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Lay the 1/4 sliced ripe cantaloupe on a plate. Drape the 3 to 4 slices of prosciutto over each slice. Drizzle with olive oil, add black pepper and flaky salt. Add fresh mint or arugula if using.

meals.notes: Only works with truly ripe, fragrant melon. If the melon is not sweet, this dish is pointless.

meals.headnote: There is no cooking trick hiding here. The pleasure comes from choosing good ingredients, arranging enough for a real meal, and changing the bite as you go.

meals.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips
meals.description: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner.

ingredients.name: frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Combine the 1/2 cup of thawed and squeezed spinach, 1/2 cup of chopped artichoke hearts, 100g of cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of sour cream, 40g of grated parmesan, and 1 clove of minced garlic in an oven safe dish. Stir to combine.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 375F/190C for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden. Broil for 2 minutes for extra color.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Let the dip stand for 2 minutes, then set the hot dish on a heatproof board. Serve with pita chips or sturdy crackers while the center is still creamy and the top is browned.

meals.notes: Squeezing every drop of water from the spinach is essential. Otherwise the dip gets watery.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bubbling golden spinach and artichoke dip served with pita chips
meals.headnote: This is more satisfying when the dip and its scoops are treated as one recipe. Keep the center creamy, the edges well seasoned, and the bread or chips close by.
meals.seoTitle: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner. A clear single-serving recipe ready in 25 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Out of marinated artichoke hearts? Anything crunchy works for scooping. The dip itself keeps for days, which makes it a good make-ahead plate.
meals.storage: Refrigerate up to four days in a sealed container. Flavor often improves overnight; stir before serving and refresh with olive oil or lemon.

meals.name: Lox Plate on Cucumber
meals.description: Smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers, and cucumber deliver all the familiar lox flavors without a bagel.

ingredients.name: English cucumber, sliced into thick rounds

steps.name: Build bites
steps.text: Slice the 1 large English cucumber into thick rounds. Spread 3 tablespoons of cream cheese on each round. Top with a small piece of the 80g of lox, 1 tablespoon of capers, a paper thin slice of red onion, and a sprig of dill.

meals.notes: These also work beautifully on endive leaves for a more elegant presentation.

steps.name: Separate and plate
steps.text: Keep everything in distinct piles on a plate. Put the handful of crackers on one side, 3 to 4 slices of deli turkey on another, and 40g of cubed cheddar in the middle. Add grapes, baby carrots, or apple slices in the gaps. No mixing required.

meals.notes: The joy is in the separateness. You eat each thing on its own or build your own stack.

meals.name: Garlic Parmesan Toast
meals.description: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan.

steps.name: Make garlic butter
steps.text: Mix the 2 tablespoons of softened butter, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 3 tablespoons of grated parmesan until combined.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Spread the mixture thickly on 2 slices of crusty bread. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes until the edges are golden and the parmesan is crispy. Add fresh parsley and chilli flakes.

meals.notes: Broiling rather than baking gives you the best crispy outside, soft inside texture.
meals.photo_search: toasted crusty bread topped with melted garlic butter and crispy parmesan
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of toasted crusty bread topped with melted garlic butter and crispy parmesan
meals.headnote: This is quick, but it still benefits from attention at the edges. Toast the bread until properly golden, season the topping, and assemble only when you are ready to eat.
meals.seoTitle: Garlic Parmesan Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan. A clear single-serving recipe ready in 11 minutes.
meals.substitutions: No salted butter? Soft cheeses, mashed avocado, or ricotta play the same role. Whatever the spread, season it directly instead of salting only the top.
meals.storage: Toast cannot be stored assembled. Keep toppings in one container and bread separately; rebuild under the broiler for a few minutes when round two calls.

meals.name: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta
meals.description: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity.

steps.name: Blister tomatoes
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over high heat. Add the 200g of cherry tomatoes and let them blister and burst, about 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of sliced garlic and chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of pasta in well salted water until al dente, saving a splash of pasta water.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Toss the pasta with the tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Remove from heat. Add 80g of torn mozzarella and basil. The residual heat melts the cheese.

meals.notes: Tearing the mozzarella rather than slicing gives you irregular melty pockets throughout the pasta.
meals.photo_search: bowl of rigatoni pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes, torn mozzarella, and fresh basil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of rigatoni pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes, torn mozzarella, and fresh basil
meals.headnote: The sauce is simple enough to make while the water heats. Reserve a splash of starchy cooking water before draining because it is what helps the whole bowl come together.
meals.seoTitle: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity. A clear single-serving recipe ready in 20 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Sauce components swap freely: if cherry tomatoes is out, any bold condiment thinned with pasta water (pesto, tapenade, chilli crisp) leads the bowl instead.
meals.storage: Refrigerate up to two days. Reheat gently in a covered pan with a splash of water to bring the sauce back to glossy; microwaving works at half power.

meals.name: Edamame with Garlic Butter and Chilli
meals.description: Steamed edamame tossed with garlic butter and chilli makes a salty, hands-on snack dinner.

steps.name: Cook edamame
steps.text: Microwave or boil the 1 cup of edamame pods until hot, then drain.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan, add 1 clove of minced garlic and a pinch of chilli flakes for 30 seconds. Toss the edamame in the garlic butter and season with flaky sea salt.

meals.notes: Eat by popping the beans directly into your mouth from the pod. The tactile experience is part of it.

meals.name: Elevated Canned Tomato Soup
meals.description: Good canned tomato bisque made significantly better with cream, butter, and basil oil.

ingredients.name: quality tomato soup or bisque (Rao's or Amy's)
basil oil or good olive oil

steps.name: Heat and enrich
steps.text: Warm the 1 can of tomato soup in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons of heavy cream and 1 tablespoon of butter until completely melted and incorporated.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a mug or bowl, drizzle with basil oil, and add crackers or croutons with flaky salt.

meals.notes: The cream and butter addition sounds minor but genuinely transforms any canned soup.

meals.seoDescription: Good canned tomato bisque made significantly better with cream, butter, and basil oil. A clear single-serving recipe ready in 10 minutes.

meals.name: Tuna Salad on Crackers
meals.description: A proper tuna salad. Mayo, celery, dijon, capers. Scooped onto crackers.

ingredients.name: quality tuna in olive oil (Wild Planet or Ortiz)

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Drain the 1 can of tuna and combine with 2 tablespoons of mayo, 1 finely diced celery stalk, 1 teaspoon of dijon, 1 tablespoon of chopped capers, and lemon juice. Season with black pepper and mix well. Taste and adjust.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Serve alongside a pile of crackers for scooping, then finish with the listed garnishes. Serve right away while the hot ingredients are hot and the crisp ingredients still have their texture.

meals.notes: Quality tuna makes a huge difference. Ortiz in olive oil is in a completely different league from generic supermarket tuna.

steps.text: Spread 60g of soft goat cheese generously on the 2 slices of toasted sourdough.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of good honey, scatter 2 tablespoons of toasted walnuts, and add fresh thyme if using.

meals.name: Shakshuka for One
meals.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A dramatic, satisfying pan dinner.

steps.name: Build sauce
steps.text: Saute the half diced onion in olive oil until soft, 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, and half a teaspoon of chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute. Pour in the 1 can of diced tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened. Season generously.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Make wells in the sauce with a spoon. Crack the 2 large eggs into the wells. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until whites are set but yolks runny.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Top with feta and parsley. Eat directly from the pan with crusty bread for dipping.

meals.notes: Serve directly from the pan. It looks dramatic and saves a dish.

meals.storage: Eggs are best straight from the pan. Leftovers keep one day covered and reheat softly in a buttered pan over low heat; avoid the microwave if texture matters.

meals.name: Cacio e Pepe
meals.description: Only three ingredients but requires technique. Cheese, pepper, and pasta water do everything.

steps.name: Toast pepper
steps.text: Toast 1.5 teaspoons of cracked pepper in a dry pan until fragrant. Boil 100g of pasta in salted water until 2 minutes before done, saving a cup of water.

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Transfer pasta to the pepper pan over medium heat, adding pasta water gradually. Remove from heat, add 50g of pecorino and 20g of parmesan, and toss vigorously until emulsified into a silky sauce.

meals.notes: Taking the pan off heat before adding cheese prevents it from seizing. The pasta water emulsion is the entire technique.

steps.text: Cook 1 portion of noodles separately and add to a bowl. Ladle the hot broth over, add 100g of cubed silken tofu, spring onions, nori, and sesame seeds.

steps.text: Mix 1/2 cup of sour cream, 2 tablespoons of cream cheese, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and Worcestershire. Fold in the cooled onions and season.

steps.name: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat the butter and olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in an even layer and leave them undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes, until deeply browned underneath. Toss and cook for 2 minutes more.

steps.name: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Pour in the cream and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until it lightly coats the mushrooms.

steps.name: Season and serve
steps.text: Season with salt, black pepper, and a small squeeze of lemon. Spoon the creamy mushrooms over the hot buttered sourdough and serve before the toast loses its crunch.

meals.notes: Do not stir mushrooms immediately. Letting them brown first is what creates the deep savory flavor.
